note: EMR-D a5 (Astra D114 consult R5A2-SQL, decision 1, section 1.5): the cases of the raw-client/receiver flow proof (tests/admin_audit_raw_flow.cjs) on producer.ts and consumer.ts. The unedited pair passes the gate with every candidate as marked and the witnesses named under `positive`; each variant puts exactly one defect of its class into it, every `find` occurring exactly once in its file, and must fail as `expect` says: `unresolved_includes` names a tagged line that is unresolved with the reason given (other entries the defect takes with it are recorded, never counted instead), `unlisted` the actions the inventory refuses. A variant that does not apply or does not parse is no kill. Nothing here is read from the checker's output; the table is empty, so any audit write is unlisted.
